# Agent Zero

> Agent Zero is an open-source autonomous engineer that finds, fixes, and verifies problems in pull requests. It ingests review feedback, validates the claim, applies a narrowly scoped fix, runs the repository's real checks, inspects the resulting diff, and produces evidence.

The runtime is a pnpm/Turborepo monorepo with strict package boundaries: `packages/agent` owns orchestration and state transitions, `packages/runner` is the only boundary allowed to execute repository commands or mutate a checkout, `packages/models` owns model-provider abstractions, `packages/github` adapts GitHub events and APIs, `packages/config` parses configuration and policy, `packages/shared` holds stable cross-package contracts, `packages/cli` handles argument parsing and terminal presentation, and `apps/server` composes the oRPC control plane.
